description: Estimates the gas a transaction would use (eth_estimateGas) and what it would cost at the node's current gas price: fee = gas × gas price, in wei and LAX. Takes the same call fields as call_contract (to, from, value_wei, and data or function+args) and nothing is sent. A plain LAX transfer uses 21,000 gas. Fails with the revert reason when the transaction would revert.

abi.description: contract ABI as a JSON string; when omitted the explorer's verified ABI is used

args.description: function arguments as a JSON array; big integers as decimal strings

function.description: function name resolved via abi or the verified ABI, or a full signature such as "balanceOf(address) returns (uint256)"

value_wei.description: LAX to send with the call, in wei (decimal)

name: estimate_gas
title: Estimate gas
